Application Data.NAME: Smith Construction Group, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith Construction Group, LLC specializes in general contracting and construction services, providing comprehensive solutions for residential and commercial projects. Our operations include project management, site development, building renovations, and new construction. We pride ourselves on maintaining a strong safety culture, implementing stringent safety protocols, and managing subcontractor relationships carefully to minimize risks associated with liability and worker safety. Our team is dedicated to delivering high-quality craftsmanship while ensuring timely project completion.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a subcontractor caused damage to a neighboring property while performing excavation work. The damage was assessed at $5,000, and the claim is currently in progress, with negotiations ongoing with the affected property owner. On July 10, 2023, a worker slipped and fell on-site, resulting in a workers' compensation claim valued at $10,000, which has been settled. Total losses to date amount to $15,000.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1 Safe - UL Listed, Fire Resistant, Burglary Resistant
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing with 24/7 monitored surveillance and periodic on-site security personnel during high-risk construction phases.
